title: [nightly/speed] Keep the brand preview harness out of production builds
summary: A build-only Vite plugin drops the dev preview harness from production, cutting the entry chunk by 174 kB (−33 kB gzip) and bringing first paint about 250 ms sooner on a slow phone. Dev, Vitest and the screenshot suites are untouched, so unlike #571 it doesn't make the screenshot tests flaky.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor @ e8c07223 (after the redesign merge), so it should apply onto factory/speed.
reviewFirst: The plugin matches only src/App.tsx importing ./brand/BrandHarness, and the build fails if that import changes.
enforce: 'pre' so it resolves before Vite's own resolver.
